subject: NovusMed demo: travel delay — contingency plan
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@novusmed.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Novus Health Field Ops <ops@novusmed.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite demo this Tue — heads up on travel delays

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Quick update from our side: the team is inbound for the Tue onsite demo but our lead contact hit a travel issue — their connecting flight to SFO was pushed and they now arrive late Tue evening. That means the execs who planned to attend in-person will not be on-site during the scheduled 10:00–11:30 demo slot.

Options I see on our end: we can either (A) shift the full onsite to Wed (their preferred), (B) keep Tue and run a condensed 45-min remote demo for the execs (they would dial in), or (C) have you run the demo for the local ops folks as planned and record it for the execs to watch, followed by a Wed follow-up for deeper questions.

We understand travel constraints — sorry for the late notice. If you have a preferred contingency please tell us; we want to keep momentum on evaluation.

Also: if you record, we need a short recording-permissions note signed by our legal — I can get that over today if needed.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Huang
Senior Program Manager, NovusMed
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@novusmed.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo this Tue — heads up on travel delays

Thanks for the heads up, Claire — appreciate you flagging this.

I recommend we do option C: run the planned local session for the ops team on Tue (we won't shorten the content), record the session, and then schedule a condensed 45–60 minute exec-focused follow-up on Wed when everyone is available. That gives your ops folks the full walkthrough they need and keeps the execs from missing the core narrative.

Quick asks from our side:
- Please confirm whether recording is ok (if you can send the legal note, we can get sign-off on our side).
- If ops will attend in person, can you share the attendee list so we tailor the demo emphasis (security/compliance vs. integration)?
- If Wed works for execs, what time zone window is best — morning PT or late morning ET?

I'll loop in Karthik for the technical portion and Connor to hold scheduling slots. If you'd rather shift the whole onsite to Wed we can do that too, but splitting keeps things moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — marissa@redwood.com
Attachment: demo-agenda.pdf (one-page agenda for Tue)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa.coole@redwood.com, Claire Huang <claire.huang@novusmed.com>
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo this Tue — heads up on travel delays

Marissa / Claire — I can run the product walkthrough for ops on Tue as planned. A few notes so the recording is useful for execs later:
- We'll focus the first 25 minutes on high-level platform value (latency/cost controls, routing, and deployment modes) and save deep integrations (API/SDK, dedicated/private options) for the follow-up.
- Please confirm if we should blur any customer-specific PII in the recording — otherwise we'll capture the live console and a quick example integration flow.
- I'll record locally and provide both the raw video and a trimmed 20–30 minute highlights cut. That should make it easy for execs to consume.

If Wed for execs is preferable: I have open slots Wed 11-Jul between 09:30–11:30 PT and 14:00–15:30 PT. Otherwise I can flex.

Attachment: recording-permissions.txt (template we can both sign)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@novusmed.com>
To: marissa.coole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com, Novus Health Field Ops <ops@novusmed.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo this Tue — heads up on travel delays

Thanks Marissa / Karthik — that plan works for us. Quick responses:
- Recording is fine; legal asked that we use the template you attached (recording-permissions.txt) and I'll return a signed copy by EOD.
- Ops attendee list: onsite will be Sam Patel (Field Ops Lead), Rita Gomez (Infra), and two engineers. I'll send calendar invites for the Tue ops session and the Wed exec slot once we confirm times.
- Execs prefer Wed morning PT; please tentatively hold 09:30–10:15 PT. We may need that to be 45 minutes.

Appreciate the flexibility. We'll get the signed permission over this morning.

Claire
From: marissa.coole@redwood.com <marissa.coole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@novusmed.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo this Tue — heads up on travel delays

Perfect — thanks Claire. Actions from Redwood:
- We will run full ops session Tue at 10:00 PT and record. Karthik will lead the recording; Connor will own the calendar invites and follow-up.
- We'll upload both the full recording and a 25–30 minute highlights cut to this Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xY-demo-materials (you'll get access when Claire confirms).
- Tentative exec follow-up held Wed 09:30–10:15 PT; Connor, once we have the signed template, please send a formal invite to Claire + exec list.

Thanks everyone — see you Tue.

Marissa
